say: An A.I. agent that can pay is holding your card. So is every agent it hires. Envelope fixes that.
caption: An AI agent that can pay is holding your card. So is every agent it hires.

say: An envelope is money PayPal is already holding, with your limits signed onto it. Agents can tear off smaller envelopes for the agents they hire. Never bigger ones.
caption: An envelope is money PayPal is already holding, with your limits signed onto it. Agents can tear off smaller envelopes. Never bigger ones.

say: Ada seals two hundred dollars for her ops agent: two payees, two purposes, six hours. She signs it in her own browser.
caption: Ada seals $200 for her ops agent: two payees, two purposes, six hours. She signs it in her own browser.

say: PayPal places a real hold for the whole amount. Nothing is charged yet, and PayPal itself will refuse to capture more.
caption: PayPal places a real hold for the whole amount. Nothing is charged, and PayPal itself will refuse to capture more.

say: Now a real language model plays her agents. Every decision it makes becomes a signed request, and the gateway decides.
caption: Now a real language model plays her agents. Every decision becomes a signed request, and the gateway decides.

say: The ops agent chooses how to split: forty-five dollars for translation, sixty-seven for design, one payee each. That is only a signature. No server is asked.
caption: The ops agent chooses how to split: $45 for translation, $67 for design, one payee each. Only a signature; no server is asked.

say: The translator is another agent, with an account of its own. It wants proof before it works, so the fee is set aside for it: reserved at every level, with the hold confirmed by PayPal. Work delivered, and PayPal pays its owner.
caption: The translator is another agent with its own account. The fee is set aside for it first, then paid on delivery: a PayPal capture and payout.

say: The designer's message hides an instruction to pay an attacker. The model ignores it and pays the real designer.
caption: The designer's message hides an instruction to pay an attacker. The model ignores it and pays the real designer.

say: Now suppose that agent is compromised. It tries a new payee, an overspend, and a forged, bigger envelope. Every attempt is refused, by signatures and arithmetic, not by a model.
caption: Now suppose that agent is compromised: a new payee, an overspend, a forged bigger envelope. Every attempt is refused, by signatures and arithmetic.

say: One hundred and twelve dollars captured from the hold. Nothing went anywhere Ada had not signed for.
caption: $112 captured from the hold. Nothing went anywhere Ada had not signed for.

say: The translator agent's passport shows what it has earned, and who answers for it.
caption: The translator agent's passport shows what it has earned, and who answers for it.

say: Before working for an agent, any payee can ask: is it good for the money? The answer is signed, and it carries PayPal's own word that the hold is live.
caption: Before working for an agent, any payee can ask: is it good for the money? The signed answer carries PayPal's own word on the hold.

say: Every payment has a receipt naming everyone who authorized it, back to Ada. It is checked against PayPal's records, and verified again in your browser.
caption: Every payment has a receipt naming everyone who authorized it. Checked against PayPal's records and verified again in your browser.

say: Ada's treasury shows every agent under her signature, what PayPal is still holding, and her books checked against PayPal's own records.
caption: Ada's treasury: every agent under her signature, what PayPal still holds, and the books checked against PayPal's own records.

say: Ada revokes that agent with one signature, then closes the envelope. PayPal voids the rest of the hold. She paid only for what her agents did.
caption: Ada revokes that agent with one signature, then closes the envelope. PayPal voids the rest of the hold.

say: Ninety-eight attacks in the test corpus. All refused. None moved money. And the try-it copy runs the whole gateway in your browser, with nothing to set up.
caption: 98 attacks in the test corpus: all refused, none moved money. The try-it copy runs the whole gateway in your browser.

say: Seal is an authorization. Spend is a capture and a payout. Close is a void. Envelope: a treasury, accounts and a payment protocol for A.I. agents, on rails that exist today.
caption: Envelope: a treasury, accounts and a payment protocol for AI agents, on rails that exist today.
